answer: Proposal: bind credentials to silicon; the registry admits an agent only with a remote attestation quote chained to the manufacturer CA, one credential per attested chip. Clones sink into one credential like karst streams into a swallow hole; N credentials need N real chips, bought or rented for the horizon, a linear per-sybil cost. It deters only while per-credential lifetime reward stays below chip cost over that span; past that vertex, renting enclaves profits. Re-quoting each epoch makes a replayed quote a relic, not admission. Open: manufacturer trust and attestation exploits.
